column1: # Every capability this product has, enumerated from the source.
# Generated by `node scripts/capabilities.mjs --list`. Do not edit by hand —
# a register somebody maintains is a register that stops agreeing with the
# code, which is the whole reason this one is derived.
# The target asked for was 1,084. It was given as a number and never as a
# list, so it cannot be ticked off — only measured against. That measurement
# is a gate: `node scripts/capabilities.mjs --check` fails the build if the
# count ever falls below it, and it runs in scripts/verify-all.mjs.
# Checks are deliberately not counted as capabilities. An assertion is how a
# capability is held, not another capability.
